_readme: The research behind every /industries/<slug>/ page. Generated by scripts/industry-page-data.py from the ranked industry file, the 60 per-industry research configs and the research library on disk. Every number and every credit here is copied from one of those files; nothing is written by hand.

sources.ranking: _data/siso-agency/industries/ranked-all.csv (3,665 industries ranked, 7 Oct 2026); cities from Overture/Maps counts in the same file
sources.configs: _data/siso-agency/industries/configs/ — 60 industries researched, each with its schema.org type, the offers it usually sells, the proof the business must supply and the claims we refuse to make
sources.library: _data/siso-agency/research/library/ — 146 documents read across 6 lanes, each with the page fetched and the date
sources.images: public/siso-img/industries/manifest.json — the prompt, attempts and inspection note for each image

lanes: Colour and type that hold up

members.name: Coffee shop
members.moduleLine: The menu is the product: dishes, prices and photos the owner can change, and an order that reaches a real endpoint.

proof: Owner-approved coffee menu with sizes and current prices
Business-supplied brewing methods and bean information
Actual drink and shop photographs with usage rights
Traceable customer ratings with source and review count
prohibited: Invented coffee origins or roast claims
Health or productivity guarantees from caffeine
Order confirmation without a connected ordering service
Unverified plant-milk or decaf availability
Fabricated prices, awards or review scores
